recipes.name: KPI Scorecard
recipes.calculation: actual / target; null or zero target = N/A
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Target vs Actual
recipes.calculation: one metric and unit on one zero-based axis
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: YoY / MoM Trend
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Variance Analysis
recipes.calculation: actual - target; percentage metric difference in pp
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Contribution Analysis
recipes.calculation: share = part / total; growth contribution = part - previous; reconcile both totals
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Management Summary
recipes.calculation: observed differences only; no inferred cause/action
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Lead Funnel
recipes.calculation: unique mature acquisition cohort -> observed outcome; optional behaviors separate
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Conversion Rate
recipes.calculation: unique outcome customers within fixed horizon / mature unique acquired customers
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Stage Drop-off
recipes.calculation: ordered first-observed target among customers reaching source; not observed is not proven lost
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Cohort Conversion
recipes.calculation: group mature customers by acquisition month, same observation horizon
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Regional / Store Comparison
recipes.calculation: first-touch region attribution, customer counts and outcome counts
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Sales Driver Analysis
recipes.calculation: optional-behavior strata and first-touch channels; descriptive association, never causal effect
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Project KPI
recipes.calculation: common delivery unit, cumulative as_of; no mixed units
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Planned vs Actual
recipes.calculation: actual - planned units, no quality or acceptance inference
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Milestone Performance
recipes.calculation: actual - planned days; null actual stays open, not zero-delay
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Resource Allocation
recipes.calculation: same human-day unit; sum only complete data
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Budget / Cost Variance
recipes.calculation: cost = days * rate + external; variance = cost - full budget, not earned value
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action

recipes.name: Risk and Delivery Overview
recipes.calculation: declared risk; realized value / cost, not projected ROI; missing value remains unknown
recipes.conclusion_boundary: Computed descriptive findings only; user or agent verifies source quality, causal explanation and action
